mapper.select: SELECT b.department_id AS deptId, b.department_name AS deptName, COALESCE(SUM(b.capacity), 0) AS total_capacity, COALESCE(SUM(s.allocated_count), 0) AS allocatedStations, COALESCE(SUM(b.capacity), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.allocated_count), 0) AS freeStations, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(s.allocated_count), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(b.capacity), 0), 0), 2) AS utilizationRate FROM bbx_space_basic_info b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT space_id, COUNT(user_id) AS allocated_count FROM bbx_station WHERE deleted = 1 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY space_id ) s ON b.space_id = s.space_id WHERE b.type = 1 AND b.deleted = 1 AND b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY b.department_id,b.department_name;
